title: Obsidian Laced Robe
summary: Resist Fire damage and retaliate after successful saves against enemy spells.

fields.Defence: Clothing, base AC 10 plus Dexterity. Fire resistance.
fields.Flaming Revenge: When you succeed on a saving throw against a foe’s spell, it takes 1d4 + your proficiency bonus Fire damage. The game does not treat you as the damage source, so this does not break Sanctuary or trigger your item damage riders.
fields.Acquisition: Buy from Quartermaster Talli by the Last Light Inn waypoint.
fields.Base value: 800 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
